# 1018 of the 1025 harvested fixtures pass. These seven are grouped by what is actually wrong, which
# is six things.

# Four entries left this list without anything being fixed, which is the thing to remember about it:
# the harness was typing setup commands through `parseKeys`, so `:nmap <Tab> ihello<Esc>` pressed
# Escape on the command line instead of writing five characters into it. IdeaVim types those
# literally and says why in a comment. Four fixtures had been recorded here as bugs in this host
# that were bugs in the harness reading them.

# --- Reindenting, which is a VS Code command and therefore asynchronous.
#
# `=` on a sentence object asks the host to reindent a range. VS Code's is a command that resolves a
# promise, and the engine wants the text changed before it returns.

# --- One each.
#
# `ideajoin` is IntelliJ's smart join, a language feature this host cannot have.
#
# `partial Action mapping` is the keys of a half-typed `<Action>` mapping, replayed as literal text
# here instead of being recognised.
#
# The two Select mode corners are block Select entered with `g<C-H>`, and where the caret lands when
# a search is run from Select mode with `<C-O>`.
#
# The incsearch one is the preview for an *ex command* - `:%s/dolor` shows its match and drops the
# Visual selection while still being typed. That needs the command line parsed for a range and a
# pattern before it is run, which is a different piece of machinery from previewing `/`.
